description: 面向证明工具的基础扩充；官方标题在下载时核对，下载不等于定理已核验。

papers.title: Introduction to the non-asymptotic analysis of random matrices
papers.why: 从 sub-Gaussian、epsilon-net 到奇异值界，补齐高维概率工具。

papers.title: User-Friendly Tail Bounds for Sums of Random Matrices
papers.why: 学习矩阵 Laplace-transform 方法与 matrix Bernstein。

papers.title: An Introduction to Matrix Concentration Inequalities
papers.why: 把矩阵浓缩的假设、方差参数和维数因子系统化。

papers.title: Time-uniform Chernoff bounds via nonnegative supermartingales
papers.why: 理解固定时刻概率界如何升级为 anytime-valid 保证。

papers.title: Time-uniform, nonparametric, nonasymptotic confidence sequences
papers.why: 将置信区间、optional stopping 和 confidence sequence 串联。

papers.title: Convex Optimization: Algorithms and Complexity
papers.why: 凸优化主干：一阶下降、对偶、mirror descent 与复杂度。

papers.title: Optimization Methods for Large-Scale Machine Learning
papers.why: 连接确定性优化、随机梯度与 variance reduction。

papers.title: Linear Convergence of Gradient and Proximal-Gradient Methods Under the Polyak-Lojasiewicz Condition
papers.why: 理解线性收敛为什么未必需要强凸。

papers.title: SPIDER: Near-Optimal Non-Convex Optimization via Stochastic Path-Integrated Differential Estimator
papers.why: 按共同随机性、估计误差递推与 refresh 三步读 variance reduction。

papers.title: A Stochastic Gradient Method with an Exponential Convergence Rate for Finite Training Sets
papers.why: 通过 SAG 理解有限和结构、梯度记忆与 Lyapunov 分析。

papers.title: User-friendly introduction to PAC-Bayes bounds
papers.why: 从先验、后验、KL 代价与概率量词建立直觉；已核对 v6 Theorem 3.2 及 T05 使用的限定接口。

papers.title: Information-theoretic analysis of generalization capability of learning algorithms
papers.why: 核对 v2 Theorem 1 的期望泛化范围；T05 以逐模型中心化的 MGF 自包含重推，避免原文混合步骤的条件缺口。

papers.title: Understanding deep learning requires rethinking generalization
papers.why: 理解拟合随机标签实验对经典复杂度解释提出的问题。

papers.title: Reconciling modern machine-learning practice and the classical bias-variance trade-off
papers.why: 把插值阈值与 double descent 接入泛化地图。

papers.title: Surprises in High-Dimensional Ridgeless Least Squares Interpolation
papers.why: 从可计算线性模型理解插值、随机矩阵与过参数化风险。

papers.title: Neural Tangent Kernel: Convergence and Generalization in Neural Networks
papers.why: 建立线性化、Gram 谱下界与宽网络训练之间的桥梁。

papers.title: Wide Neural Networks of Any Depth Evolve as Linear Models Under Gradient Descent
papers.why: 明确有限宽网络与线性化模型相近所需的尺度和时间条件。

papers.title: On Lazy Training in Differentiable Programming
papers.why: 理解 lazy regime 来自参数化与尺度，而不是所有网络的本质。

papers.title: A Mean Field View of the Landscape of Two-Layers Neural Networks
papers.why: 从粒子经验测度进入分布空间中的梯度流。

papers.title: The Implicit Bias of Gradient Descent on Separable Data
papers.why: 核对 v7 的线性 logistic GD 条件、Lemma 1 与 Theorem 3 陈述，区分 loss、参数与方向极限；未重证完整附录。

papers.title: Transformers learn in-context by gradient descent
papers.why: 沿构造性等式阅读 attention 与梯度更新的连接。

papers.title: What learning algorithm is in-context learning? Investigations with linear models
papers.why: 区分模型能够实现、训练能否学到、实际学到了什么。

papers.title: An Explanation of In-context Learning as Implicit Bayesian Inference
papers.why: 从潜在任务变量与 Bayesian inference 理解 ICL 的另一条解释。

papers.title: Online Least Squares Estimation with Self-Normalized Processes: An Application to Bandit Problems
papers.why: 从 self-normalized 浓缩走到在线最小二乘与 bandit 置信集。该 arXiv 长版不冒充同作者的 NeurIPS 会议题目。

papers.title: Regret Analysis of Stochastic and Nonstochastic Multi-armed Bandit Problems
papers.why: 连接 stochastic/adversarial bandit 的上界和信息下界。

papers.title: Is Pessimism Provably Efficient for Offline RL?
papers.why: 理解离线覆盖不足为何需要 pessimism，而非直接照搬 optimism。

papers.title: Trust Region Policy Optimization
papers.why: 从 performance difference 到代理目标，再审查 trust-region 近似。

papers.title: Doubly Robust Off-policy Value Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning
papers.why: 把 contextual DR 扩展到序列决策，辨认重要性权重与方差。

papers.title: Double/Debiased Machine Learning for Treatment and Structural Parameters
papers.why: 理解 Neyman orthogonality、nuisance product error 和 cross-fitting。

papers.title: A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification
papers.why: 从交换性和名次对称性推有限样本 marginal coverage。

papers.title: Conformal Risk Control
papers.why: 从覆盖集合延伸到一般单调风险，同时说明二者保证不同。

papers.title: An Introductory Guide to Fano's Inequality with Applications in Statistical Estimation
papers.why: 从 packing、testing reduction 到 Fano，补可迁移的下界推导。

papers.title: Lower Bounds for Non-Convex Stochastic Optimization
papers.why: 理解 oracle 模型、hard instance 和算法量词怎样决定最优 rate。

papers.title: Computational Optimal Transport
papers.why: 连接 coupling、Kantorovich 对偶、Wasserstein 和熵正则。

papers.title: Sinkhorn Distances: Lightspeed Computation of Optimal Transportation Distances
papers.why: 理解熵正则带来的可计算性与相对原始 OT 的偏差。

papers.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.why: 统一 score、reverse SDE 与 probability-flow ODE 的对象和方向。

papers.title: Sampling is as easy as learning the score: theory for diffusion models with minimal data assumptions
papers.why: 学习 score error、离散化和初始化误差的同一度量分解。

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.why: 从 conditional velocity 到 marginal velocity，核对梯度等价条件。

papers.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
papers.why: 区分端点 coupling、条件直线、边缘轨迹与 reflow。

papers.title: Consistency Models
papers.why: 把瞬时向量场与 trajectory endpoint map 的证明对象拆开。

papers.title: A Theoretical Analysis of Contrastive Unsupervised Representation Learning
papers.why: 检查 contrastive objective 怎样在特定潜在类别假设下关联下游风险。

papers.title: Understanding Contrastive Representation Learning through Alignment and Uniformity on the Hypersphere
papers.why: 从球面几何理解 alignment/uniformity，并区分渐近结果与有限 batch。
